text:
alex c: Quick heads-up — PR #19845 (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/19845) needs a merge slot today but CI is running really slow. Can we move the current 10:00 UTC merge window to 12:00 UTC? Blocking detail: there's a DB migration scheduled 23:00 PST tonight, so I want this merged after the canary runs but before the migration prep. Need: approvals + a CI slot swap.

sophia: @alex c can you paste the failing job snippet? if it's just mac-matrix we can rerun in a different slot. also FYI deploy-freeze starts in 36h so still safe today :+1:

alex c: failing on `integration/payment_flow` only on mac-12. Logs are noisy but look like flakiness not deterministic. here's the failing tail: 
```
E 00:12:03 payment_test.go:142: expected 200 got 502
--- FAIL: TestPaymentFlow (0.45s)
+ expected: 200
- got: 502
```

jamal: i'll take a look at the test. might be a network timeout to the mock gateway. if it's a flaky test i'm ok with an exception to the usual gate, but we should run two clean CI passes before merging.

linda: @release-manager our reserved slot at 10:00 is booked for canary smoke. we can swap with the 12:00 slot if someone gives a hard +1 on the PR. dropping a note to ops to see if moving canary is ok.

ops-oncall: canary shift is possible but prefer not to move infra smoke later than 12:30 UTC. if you want 12:00 we should be fine. ping me when ready and i'll update the schedule.

alex c: thanks. jamal — if you think it's flaky i'll rerun mac-only now and post results. command i use: 
```
# rerun mac matrix for PR
./scripts/ci rerun --pr 19845 --matrix macos
```

ci-bot: Re-run scheduled: macos matrix for PR 19845 queued on runner-group:mac-pool-2. ETA ~18m.

jamal: started a quick local repro, looks like mock gateway had a transient 502. i pushed a tiny timeout bump that should make the test robust (small PR to same branch). will update CI in ~10m.

alex c: pushing that fix now, will trigger another mac rerun once CI-bot green. if green twice we should be safe to swap slots. @release-manager any objection to swapping 10:00 -> 12:00?

release-manager: no objection. i need lgtm from two reviewers and green CI twice. if you hit flake again we'll defer to tomorrow morning fallback.

linda: swapping slots now — 10:00 -> 12:00. canary stays at 12:30 so ops-oncall please note.

ci-bot: macos matrix for PR 19845: all checks passed (2/2).

jamal: looks good from my side, leaving review comment about tightening the mock, but approving.

alex c: @sophia @linda @jamal thanks — i've added the changelog note and addressable tests comment. requesting final approval: please react with :+1: if ok.

sophia: :+1: approved.

linda: :+1: approved and slot swap confirmed.

alex c: merging in ~5m. will monitor post-merge canary and abort if anything odd. thanks everyone. :rocket:

ci-bot: Merge executed: PR 19845 merged to main by alex c at 4339987890. Deploy pipeline triggered (canary at 12:30 UTC).

ops-oncall: monitoring enabled, will post an update if we see errors during canary. good job coordinating.
